description.en: A web page next to the chat, whose console and DOM the agent can read.
description.fr: Une page web à côté du chat, dont l'agent peut lire la console et le DOM.

agentTools.name: browser_open
agentTools.description: Open a URL in the side browser. Use it to look at a page the user is working on, for example a dev server you just started.

url.description: Absolute or host:port URL to open.

agentTools.name: browser_console
agentTools.description: Read the console messages logged by the page currently open in the side browser, newest last. Use it to diagnose a runtime error the user reports.

agentTools.name: browser_dom
agentTools.description: Read the HTML of an element in the page currently open in the side browser. Argument: selector (a CSS selector, defaults to body).

agentTools.name: browser_screenshot
agentTools.description: Capture the page currently open in the side browser to a PNG file and return its path.
